title: Each event joins a physical and a mental line of causation

statements.text: Closing the causal gap this way gives two parallel lines of causation: a physical line under the Schrodinger equation that generates potentialities, and a mental line that carries the intention of an earlier experience into the attention of a later one. The two join as the physical and mental poles of each quantum event.

sources.quote: These two causal strands, one physical and one mental, join to form the physical and mental poles of a succeeding quantum event.
